podcast.body: This song is from The Stooges' 1973 album, *Raw Power*. The album was produced with financial backing secured by David Bowie, who believed in Iggy Pop's intelligence and unique talent despite his struggles with drugs and mental instability. "Iggy Pop and the Stooges from 1973's RAW Power album, that's called Search and Destroy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track is from The Stooges' 1973 album *Raw Power*. It has become a classic and has been covered by major artists such as the Red Hot Chili Peppers, Guns N' Roses, and Death Leopard, with Henry Rollins even having the title tattooed on his back. "The studio is from Raw Power with search and destroy. A classic now."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
